message:
You know that moment when you finally feel like the grown-up in the room? 🤔 This past weekend, we spent a few hours organizing our go-bags and checking off our family emergency plans. I was surprised at how good it felt to have everything in one place, ready to go. 

It wasn’t just about the supplies, but the peace of mind that comes with knowing we’re a bit more prepared than we were before. It’s like finally finding that missing puzzle piece in the chaos of life. 

Here’s to being the prepared one for once! What’s one thing you’re proud to have ready? 😊
